title: Chemistry XII — Complete Course
description: Grade XII Chemistry course with 13 chapter units, lessons, MCQs, CRQs, ERQs and Urdu/Sindhi support.

lessons.title: 1.1 Periodic trends
lessons.content:
## Learning outcomes
Explain Periodic trends in the context of Chemistry of Representative Elements.

Periodic trends is understood through atomic and molecular structure, characteristic properties, chemical reactions and applications. Use balanced equations where relevant and relate the explanation to experimental observations.

**Study task:** Define key terms, explain the principle, identify an equation or diagram where relevant, and solve a textbook-style example.

lessons.content:
## Learning outcomes
Explain Carboxyl group in the context of Carbonyl Compounds II: Carboxylic Acids and Functional Derivatives.
